resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Inserting Data[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

SQL tables store data in rows, one row after another. The [b]INSERT INTO[/b] statement is used to add [b]new rows[/b] of data to a table in the database. 
[s0l0!-header]The SQL [b]INSERT INTO[/b] syntax is as follows:[/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" ][b]INSERT INTO[/b] table_name
[b]VALUES [/b](value1, value2, value3,...);[/code]
[note]Make sure the order of the values is in the same order as the columns in the table. [/note]
[s0l0!-header]Consider the following [b]Employees [/b]table:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2844" width="100%"][s0l0!-header][b]Use the following SQL statement to insert a new row:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" codeId="3069"][b]INSERT INTO[/b] Employees 
[b]VALUES [/b](8, 'Anthony', 'Young', 35);[/code]
The values are comma-separated and their order corresponds to the columns in the table.
[s0l0!-header][b]Result: [/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2845" width="100%"]
[note]When inserting records into a table using the SQL INSERT statement, you must provide a value for every column that does not have a default value, or does not support NULL.[/note]

resolved.title: 车库库存更新及查询
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在经营一项汽车租赁服务，并有很多车存放在车库中，其中车库表**Garage** 存放了所有的汽车数据，如下：

![](/content/assets/a349280c758d4426b5c9.jpeg)

你计划在车库里再增加两辆车：

```text
6,    'Mercedes-Benz',   'G 63',   2020
7,   'Porsche',    'Panamera',     2020
```

请写一个查询，将新车插入到车库表**Garage**中， 然后查询所有汽车信息。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The INSERT Statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You have started a car rental service and have the following cars:

[b]Garage[/b][img id="4499" width="100%"]
You plan to add two more vehicles to your garage:
6,    'Mercedes-Benz',   'G 63',   2020
7,   'Porsche',    'Panamera',     2020

Write a query to insert the new cars into your table named 'Garage'.  Then show the table with the added records.
[note]Use the [b]INSERT[/b] statement to perform the operation.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
INSERT INTO Garage (ID, Make, Model, prodYear)
VALUES
( 6,'Mercedes-Benz','G 63', 2020),
( 7,'Porsche','Panamera',2020);
Select * from Garage

[s0l0!-header][h1]Inserting Data[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Alternatively, you can specify the table's column names in the INSERT INTO statement:[code format="sql" ]INSERT INTO table_name[b] (column1, column2, column3, ...,columnN)  [/b]
VALUES (value1, value2, value3,...valueN);[/code]
column1, column2, ..., columnN are the names of the columns that you want to insert data into.[code format="sql" codeId="3070"]INSERT INTO Employees[b] (ID, FirstName, LastName, Age) [/b]
VALUES (8, 'Anthony', 'Young', 35);[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]This will insert the data into the corresponding columns:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2845" width="100%"]
[note]You can specify your own column order, as long as the values are specified in the same order as the columns.[/note]
